content_sections.heading: DSWO Kanchipuram Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 2 for Case Worker and 1 for Security.

content_sections.heading: DSWO Kanchipuram Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Case Worker: Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Counselling Psychology, or Development Management with a minimum of 1 year's experience of working on violence against women issues in an administrative set up with Government or Non-Government Programmes or Projects or preferably 1 year experience of counseling either within or outside the same set-up. Candidates with Master's Degree may also apply. Security: Literate (8th pass) with at least 3 years of experience of working as a Security Purpose etc.

content_sections.heading: DSWO Kanchipuram Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Case Worker: Rs. 18,800 p.m. Security: Rs. 12,000 p.m.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DSWO Kanchipuram Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DSWO Kanchipuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the DSWO Kanchipuram Recruitment 2026 is 10 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DSWO Kanchipuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Case Worker and Security posts in the District Social Welfare Office Kanchipuram Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Case Worker post?
faq.answer: For the Case Worker position, candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Counselling Psychology, or Development Management. A Master's degree is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification for the Security post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Security post is being literate, which means having passed the 8th standard. Additionally, 3 years of relevant experience is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Case Worker and Security posts?
faq.answer: The Case Worker post offers a salary of Rs. 18,800 per month, while the Security post offers Rs. 12,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DSWO Kanchipuram Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to send their applications via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for the Case Worker and Security posts is contract-based.

faq.question: Q8. Where should I send the application form?
faq.answer: The application form should be sent to the District Social Welfare Officer, Old District Social Welfare Office, Old DRDA Building, Collectorate Campus, Kanchipuram - 631 501.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the field of work for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment falls under the healthcare field, specifically related to social welfare and support services.
